operator-walkthrough.ref: Admin UI v1 Wave 1, what the crew sees on an iPhone after this merges. Open nickstire.org/admin: the shell is graphite (#0B0C0E background, #15171A cards, white primary) instead of black and gold; the scan-line overlay, the topbar blur and the glowing, counting-up numbers are gone; every label is sentence case ('Needs action', 'Bookings today', 'Afternoon · daily brief') instead of tracked capitals; no em dashes or emoji in the chrome. A bottom bar sits in the thumb zone: Today, Lot, Approvals, Customers, Search (front desk and tech see the sections their role may open, topped up from the Daily group); the Quick-actions FAB is gone and Search opens the same command palette; the Today badge is a red count, the Approvals badge is gold, the one gold besides the Needs action card when it has items. The hamburger drawer still lists every section and covers the bar when open. Every shell control is 48 px (hamburger, topbar actions, density toggle, sidebar rows, bar slots) and Today's chips, queue buttons and call and text links are 48 px; the Tires tab strip scrolls sideways instead of overflowing. Customer-facing text is unchanged: the four SMS prefills (win-back, missed-call return, declined estimate, unpaid invoice) and the walk-in quote lines are byte-identical to main and pinned by client/src/__tests__/admin-customer-copy-pins.test.ts. The theme toggle is gone (the admin is always graphite and forces the dark class while mounted). Verified by the fixture harness render at 390 and 1440 (tests/e2e/admin-v1-fixtures.spec.ts, 6 passed on this tree: Today, Lot and Approvals render fixture rows with zero first-party errors) and measured against the six frozen pre-W1 renders committed under tests/e2e/admin-v1-baselines (Today at 390 scores 0.296 on the W0b distance measure; the 0.35 gate belongs to W2). Tests: admin-w1-shell, admin-tab-bar, admin-tabbar-scroll, admin-portal-tokens, admin-dark-class, admin-statcard-value, admin-customer-copy-pins, server/mobileErgonomics (bar instead of FAB); 138 client files / 1,927 tests green on the combined tree. Not device-tested: Nour's own look on his phone is owed after the deploy.
